articles.title: India Passes US as ChatGPT's Largest Market as Users Double

articles.title: Canva Cuts 1,271 Jobs as AI Costs and Chatbots Squeeze a Decade of Growth

articles.image_caption: Canva
articles.nri_angle: Canva is a daily tool for many diaspora creators and small businesses; its AI cost squeeze mirrors what Indian SaaS and design teams are facing on serving costs.

articles.title: Infosys Opens 1.1 Million Square Foot Block at Hyderabad Pocharam Campus

articles.image_caption: Infosys

articles.title: Qualcomm Edges Past Estimates but Shares Fall 7% on Soft Outlook

articles.title: Google's November Android Update Fixes 216 Flaws, 23 of Them Critical
articles.excerpt: The November 2026 security bulletin patches a zero-interaction remote code execution bug and an 'SMS of Death' flaw that can crash the calling service.
articles.image_caption: Android
articles.nri_angle: Android is the default phone platform for most users in India and much of the diaspora; whether a phone still receives monthly patches decides whether these 216 fixes, including a zero-interaction exploit, ever arrive.

articles.title: Google Dismantles XCPE Botnet Hidden in 1.3 Million Android TV Boxes
articles.excerpt: Google says Videostrong, an Android device maker, intentionally preloaded a firmware backdoor that turned its set-top boxes into a proxy and ad-fraud botnet, and it has banned the company from certified Android devices after a coordinated takedown.

sources.label: Google Cloud Blog / Google Threat Intelligence Group

articles.title: Anthropic IPO Is Chance to End Deferred Stock Pay, FT Argues
articles.excerpt: The Financial Times used Anthropic's listing to argue, as opinion, that regulators should stop letting companies defer stock-based compensation costs, a practice that leaves $23.7 billion of Anthropic employee pay to be recognized only after its IPO.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian-origin technology workers and investors weighing the Anthropic listing, the filing shows $23.7 billion of stock compensation still to be recognized after the IPO, a cost the adjusted profit figures add back.

articles.title: Google Makes School Search and AI Off by Default — and Schools Still Cannot Get Search Without AI

After a backlash, it clarified schools can decline Gemini and keep Search — but Search itself now comes with AI Overviews that cannot be switched off.
articles.nri_angle: Indian parents in US school districts are directly affected: whether a child school account has Search, and what AI comes with it, is now a district administrator decision, not a Google default.

articles.title: Google Extends Voluntary Exit Offers to Staff in Five More Countries as AI Costs Rise

articles.image_caption: The Google logo on a company office building. Google confirmed it extended voluntary exit packages to some employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland from June.
articles.nri_angle: Indian technology professionals in Google offices outside India are not directly affected by this round, but the pattern — buyouts everywhere except AI and cloud — is the clearest signal yet of where tech hiring is concentrating.

articles.title: Sam Altman: Human Control Must Ultimately Constrain AI Progress
articles.excerpt: In a post on X, the OpenAI chief executive said people must never be reduced to doing what AI systems decide to reward — and that keeping humans in control should set a ceiling on how far AI advances.

articles.title: A Thermodynamic Boundary Shows How Organic Solar Cells Can Lose Less Voltage
articles.excerpt: By testing five donor materials against 15 acceptors, a Chiba University-led team found the energy point at which organic cells keep their current while shedding less voltage — and that stiffer donor molecules help them sit there.

articles.nri_angle: Organic photovoltaics are a field where Indian research groups and diaspora scientists are active; a clearer design rule for cutting voltage losses matters to anyone tracking where lightweight solar goes next.

articles.title: Windows 11 Gains Cloud Rebuild: Reinstall From the Cloud Even When the PC Won't Boot
articles.excerpt: The KB5127936 preview update downloads a Windows image and your drivers from Windows Update — no USB stick needed — but it wipes the system disk, so read the warning first.
articles.image_caption: A graphic shows a laptop beneath a cloud carrying the Windows logo. Cloud rebuild reinstalls Windows 11 using an image and drivers downloaded from Windows Update, even when the PC cannot start.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora tech workers and the family members who are their default IT support, a no-USB rebuild makes rescuing a parent's dead PC a phone-guided job.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.step: Install the optional KB5127936 preview update
steps.detail: Settings > Windows Update > Advanced options > Optional updates. The feature rolls out gradually, so it may not appear immediately.

steps.step: Back up anything stored only on the PC
steps.detail: Cloud rebuild reformats the system disk and removes all local files, accounts, apps and settings. Cloud-stored files are unaffected.
If the PC boots: Settings > System > Recovery > Rebuild PC. If it does not: in WinRE, choose Troubleshoot > Recovery and uninstall > Cloud rebuild.
Join Ethernet or Wi-Fi, review the target build, edition and language, and confirm the data-loss warning. Keep the PC plugged in.
"Remove files" is faster; "Remove & sanitize files" is irreversible and is the right choice before selling or handing on the PC.

articles.title: Chrome Can Now Pull Booking Codes and Order Numbers From Your Gmail
articles.excerpt: Google's Gemini-powered enhanced autofill suggests flight bookings, tracking numbers and order details from your inbox as you fill forms — US-only, opt-in, and easy to switch off.
articles.nri_angle: Frequent US-India travellers are among the heaviest users of flight booking codes and tracking numbers the feature is built to surface.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

steps.detail: Use the three-dot menu, then Settings.
Select Enhanced autofill inside that section.

steps.step: Turn off 'Find and fill with Gemini'
steps.detail: This stops Gmail-based suggestions while leaving regular autofill intact.
In Gemini settings, under Connected Apps, disconnect Gmail to stop Gemini reading your mail at all.

articles.title: ISRO Launches NVS-03 Successfully, Restoring NavIC to Full Working Strength
articles.excerpt: GSLV-F18 placed the 2,232 kg navigation satellite in its intended orbit late on October 30, returning India's NavIC constellation to its four-satellite minimum and adding the smartphone-friendly L1 signal.
articles.image_caption: A second-generation NavIC satellite of the NVS series (file image). ISRO launched NVS-03, restoring NavIC to full working strength.
articles.nri_angle: NavIC's restored constellation and new L1 signal strengthen India's independent positioning system that diaspora travellers and devices increasingly rely on in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: KLA Revenue Jumps 29 Percent as AI Demand Lifts Chip Equipment Market Toward 2027
articles.excerpt: KLA beat estimates with $4.14 billion in quarterly revenue and guided higher, as Gartner forecasts semiconductor sales approaching $1.94 trillion in 2027.
articles.nri_angle: AI chip demand is reshaping semiconductor jobs and investment flows that affect Indian technology workers and investors worldwide.

articles.title: Infosys Opens 1.1 Million Sq Ft Block at Hyderabad Pocharam Campus
articles.excerpt: The new Pocharam block adds 10,000 seats and aims to support more than 13,000 additional employees under a hybrid model across a 450-acre campus.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian technology professionals abroad who collaborate with Hyderabad delivery teams, the expanded Pocharam campus adds capacity for global client work in AI, cloud and cybersecurity.

articles.title: SpaceX Fires Up Ship 42 as Flight 15 Targets First-Ever Starship Tower Catch
articles.excerpt: SpaceX has completed static-fire tests on both stages of Starship Flight 15 — a full six-engine burn and a single-engine deorbit rehearsal on Ship 42, after a 33-engine firing of Booster 22 — ahead of a November launch that aims to catch both stages at the tower.
articles.image_caption: Starship's Ship 42 upper stage stands on its test stand at Starbase, Texas, in a graphic marking its six-engine static fire. Ship 42 completed full-duration six-engine and single-engine static fires ahead of Flight 15.
articles.nri_angle: Starship's progress toward full reusability is closely watched by India's growing space sector and diaspora engineers across the US aerospace industry.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: ISRO's NVS-03 Launch Tonight Aims to Restore NavIC's Standalone Positioning
articles.excerpt: GSLV-F18 is set to lift off at 11:51 p.m. IST on October 30 carrying NVS-03, which would take NavIC to four working navigation satellites — the minimum for standalone positioning — after years of clock failures and the NVS-02 setback.
articles.image_caption: A GSLV rocket stands on the launch pad at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. GSLV-F18 is scheduled to carry the NVS-03 navigation satellite into orbit on the night of October 30.
articles.nri_angle: NavIC is the positioning system India's phones, vehicles and defence users rely on as a home-grown alternative to GPS; its recovery affects services across India and 1,500 km beyond its borders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
